semantic.justification: Task202610231627-0F8SYR: Writer import API attachment uses canonical document/nodes/registered positions/items rather than a separate document representation. Document-owned internal UNO marks with registered positions, distinct from user bookmarks. Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim.
